variant.briefing:
Got all our prospects at [Location] busy preppin’ for an upcoming job so there’s a bunch of boxes sitting there that need to be moved to other parts of the outpost. Feel like making some easy creds doing it for us? 

Everything can be picked up from [Location]. Then moved around the outpost to these spots:   

Package #[Item1] to [Destination].
Package #[Item4] to [Destination].
Package #[Item5] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item2] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item3] to [Destination2].

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows
